description: This file contains CSS styles for the theme management and layout of the Todo application. It defines variables for light and dark themes, styles for various components such as headers, links, and buttons, and includes responsive design adjustments.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The main application container that applies overall styling, including background and text colors based on theme.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styles for the application header with layout and color adjustments.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styling for the application links, including color transitions.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the theme toggle button, including layout, color, and hover effects.
